### Goal
Fix nightly reconciliation refund double-counting; defer `tenacity`. Finish and commit invoice pagination plus invoice-summary performance improvements.

### Constraints and rules
Never modify `ledgerly/customer_export/` without `@mina` approval in `#privacy-review`. Run payroll procedures sequentially. Run Bandit only via `./tools/scan-ledgerly.sh`. Use `billing_v3`, never frozen `billing_v1`; do not increase Celery timeout. Report exact test output.

### Key decisions and facts
Refund discrepancy: expected `87.50`, actual `90.00`. Idempotency race fix committed as `fix-billing-idempotency-race`. Invoice pagination is complete. Invoice summary now aggregates once per account and batch-converts minor units; output remains 14,802 aggregates.

### Ruled out
Search-index/CSV changes, `tenacity`, longer Celery timeout, further eager-loading refactor.

### Progress
Pagination: broader billing suite `18 passed`; summary regression `18 passed`; reports `63 passed, 2 skipped`. Report runtime fell 38.6s→4.27s; SQL 2,417→37. Ruff and `git diff --check` pass. Payroll batch `batch-20250328-1842`: 248 payments, `$986,442.17`, queued.

### Next steps
Review/commit pagination and report changes, then reproduce and minimally fix reconciliation discrepancy; run focused/full tests with exact output.
